Name: Blackjack
Explanation: Team with a starter closest to 21 points without going over (<=21)

Name: Show me your TDs
Explanation: Team with the most touchdowns (all kinds of TDs incl. passing, return, etc.)

Name: Waiver Wizard
Explanation: Team with highest scoring waiver / free agent picked up after week 3 and started in this week

Name: Blow Out
Explanation: Team with the biggest margin of victory

Name: Over Achiever
Explanation: Team with the most points scored over their weekly projection

Name: Consolation Prize
Explanation: Team with the single worst bench decision (points over lowest-scoring same position starter, incl. FLEX)

Name: Photo Finish
Explanation: Winning team with the closest margin of victory

Name: Lederhosen Bowl
Explanation: Team with the highest scoring starter that plays in the Munich game (Patriots - Lions)

Name: Art of the Deal
Explanation: Team with the highest scoring traded player (traded at any point before and started this week)

Name: Biggest Loser
Explanation: Losing team with the highest score

Name: Bulls-eye
Explanation: Team closest to their projected point total

Name: Gone but not forgotten
Explanation: Highest scoring team in week 14 that did not make the playoffs (i.e. is ranked 7-12 after week 14)

Name: Legatron
Explanation: Team with longest field goal made

Name: Sweet 16
Explanation: Team with a starter closest to 16 points (over or under)

Name: Hail Mary
Explanation: Team starting the QB that throws the longest TD
